subject: Media Literacy
title: Email and Message Scanning
description: A quick, practical guide to Email and Message Scanning.

hook.text: You email a friend about a vacation. That afternoon, you see hotel ads for the exact destination. Your email was read.

buildup.text: Free email services scan message content to build advertising profiles and serve targeted ads.

discovery.text: Gmail processes billions of emails daily. Google stopped ad scanning in 2017, but automated analysis continues for other uses.

twist.text: End-to-end encryption prevents scanning. But most popular email services don't offer it by default.

climax.text: Free email isn't free. You pay with the content of your private conversations being analyzed.

punchline.text: Your private email is only private if no one else can read it. Most services can.

quiz.question: How do free email services monetize their product?
options: By scanning message content to build advertising profiles
They don't — email is a public service
